description: Third-party exposures at subsidiaries that are reporting entities are reported for the consolidated entity and the subsidiary reporting entity
Collateral swaps are reported in both Inflows-Secured and Outflows-Secured
Collateral received via secured lending and pre-positioned at a central bank or GSE appears in I.S (Unencumbered = false) and I.A.2 Capacity
Loans and leases are reported in I.U / I.S by counterparty and in the I.A table at market value
Encumbered assets are reported under I.A.7 and under the product they are encumbered to in O.W, O.S or S.DC (Collateral Value / Market Value)
Unsecured derivative cash flows over the next 30 days are in I.O.1 / O.O.1 and in the I.O.7 / O.O.20 net
Derivative collateral flows over the next 30 days are in I.O.2 / O.O.2 and in the I.O.7 / O.O.20 net
FX transactions maturing over the next 30 days are in S.FX.1-3 and in the I.O.7 / O.O.20 net
Forward purchases (I.A.6) and sales (O.S.8 Unsettled - Forward) over the next 30 days are in the I.O.7 / O.O.20 net
Debt maturing beyond 30 days where the firm is primary market maker is in O.W and in S.L.4 / S.L.5
O.O.13-O.O.16 Total Collateral Required are cumulative: 1 notch <= 2 notch <= 3 notch <= change in financial condition
O.O.9-O.O.12 Loss of Rehypothecation Rights are cumulative: 1 notch <= 2 notch <= 3 notch <= change in financial condition
I.O.2 Collateral Called for Receipt with Maturity Bucket Open is also in the stock of S.DC.7 / S.DC.10
O.O.2 Collateral Called for Delivery with Maturity Bucket Open is also in the stock of S.DC.5 / S.DC.6 / S.DC.8 / S.DC.9
S.DC.14 Collateral Disputes Receivables is also reflected in I.O.2
S.DC.13 Collateral Disputes Deliverables is also reflected in O.O.2
S.DC.17 Sleeper Collateral Receivables is included in S.DC.5 / S.DC.6 / S.DC.8 / S.DC.9
S.DC.15 Sleeper Collateral Deliverables is included in S.DC.7 / S.DC.10
S.L.1, S.L.2, S.L.7, S.L.8 and S.I.6 correspond to amounts reported elsewhere in the submission
O.D.12 Other Product Sweep Accounts are also reported in the product the funds are swept into
I.O.8 Principal Payments on Unencumbered Investment Securities: the securities are also in I.A.1 / I.A.2
